name: uk-transfer-pricing
description: UK transfer pricing under TIOPA 2010 Part 4 for chargeable periods beginning in 2026, after the Finance Act 2026 reform. Covers the arm's length rule (s.147), the participation condition and its new extensions (ss.148A, 162A, 162B), the SME exemption defined through the EU Recommendation 2003/361 euro limits (ss.166 to 173), the new UK-to-UK exemption (s.164A), the unassessed transfer pricing profits charge that replaced diverted profits tax (Part 4A, ss.217A to 217T, CT rate plus 6 points), master file and local file records (SI 2023/818), country-by-country reporting (EUR 750m), the planned international controlled transactions schedule, method choice and benchmarking, compensating adjustments, APAs and penalties. Tax year 2026. Trigger on: TIOPA Part 4, arm's length UK, UTPP, unassessed transfer pricing profits, DPT repeal, UK-to-UK exemption, SME exemption transfer pricing, local file UK, CbCR UK, ICTS. Out of scope: CT rates and base (uk-corporation-tax), non-resident individuals
